config.script:
userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	values = self.view.params.value
	modeSourceId = system.kanoa.asset.getModeSourceId('Operator')
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', {'message': 'Setting asset mode to %s'%values['mode']})
#	system.kanoa.event.assetOperationChange(values['assetId'], values['code'], None, None, modeSourceId, system.date.now(), True, userId)
	vals = self.view.params.value
	assetOperationInfo = {'assetId': vals['assetId'], 'modeCode': vals['code'], 'workOrderId': None, 'itemId': None, 'standardRate': None, 'modeSourceId': modeSourceId, 'tStamp': system.date.now(), 'includeChildren': True}
	modeEventId, msg = system.kanoa.event.assetOperationChange(assetOperationInfo, userId)
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'Could not change operation. %s'%msg})
	else: 
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Asset has been set to %s'%values['mode']})
		system.tag.writeBlocking([system.kanoa.asset.getAssetTagPath({'assetId':values['assetId']}) + '/Line/OEE/scheduleBlockId'], [None]) #Clear the scheduleBlockId. We should put this in the assetOperationChange, but for now, we'll call it from here
	return
	
	assetInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({"assetId": values['assetId']}), 0)
	count = 0
	import time
	while count < 10:
		count += 1	
		if system.tag.read("[Kanoa]kanoa/timers/updateAssetOEETimer/update").value == False: break
#		system.perspective.print("Waiting to update asset")
		time.sleep(0.5)
		
	system.tag.writeBlocking([assetInfo['tagPath'] + '/Line/OEE/refresh'], [True]) #Let's refresh this assetTagInfo
	
	return

transforms.code: return value['enabled'] and value['code'] is not None
return value['mode'] if value['code'] is not None else '%s %s'%(value['mode'], ' (no code assigned)')
